title: Paul asks to speak to the people
description: When Paul was about to be taken into the fortress after being rescued from the mob, he asked the commander for permission to speak. The commander was surprised that he could speak Greek and thought he was the Egyptian who had led a revolt with four thousand sicarii. Paul replied that he was a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, and was granted permission to speak. From the steps he gestured with his hand, and when it became quiet, he spoke to the people in Hebrew.
